text: ok so what about the larger you go, double the map, then again, and again, whats the results
resolution: Ran the larger parity scaling checks the user asked for. 4096x4096 completed byte-identical with TypeScript at 1952ms wall and Zig at 214ms wall. 8192x8192 could not complete on the TypeScript side because V8 hit its heap limit after repeated mark-compacts; the Zig compiler alone completed the same 8192 source in 810.390ms and wrote a 295,830,608-byte gamefile.
